working_name: Erased category reappears through testimony and opportunities

component_ideas.proposition: If an agent teaches a user a vocabulary for explaining themselves, deleting the profile can leave subsequent fresh interviews reproducing the same categories and make reset appear ineffective or preferences appear independent.
If an assistant supplies the categories used by later independent reviewers, agreement across reviewers can reflect shared framing rather than robustness of the underlying evidence.

If an agent classifies a disputed category before long-term evidence matures and institutions immediately build services around it, later evidence can fail to revise the category because revision would disrupt those services.

original.emergent_property: Deleting all old profiles can leave a self-regenerating classification sustained by fresh testimony and newly produced behavior rather than hidden retained data.
original.surprising_prediction: A database reset changes outcomes little when vocabulary and opportunity allocation remain; a reset paired with alternative-description elicitation and profile-independent opportunities changes them even with identical stored-data deletion.
original.strongest_version: Conditional on the specified state dependencies: Deleting all old profiles can leave a self-regenerating classification sustained by fresh testimony and newly produced behavior rather than hidden retained data. The distinguishing contrast is: A database reset changes outcomes little when vocabulary and opportunity allocation remain; a reset paired with alternative-description elicitation and profile-independent opportunities changes them even with identical stored-data deletion.

signed_edges.edge: category language teaching → self-description in category (+)
category self-description → independently sampled category confirmations (+)

causal_loop.closure_or_threshold: Assume classification affects opportunities and those opportunities affect later evidence. Hysteresis can occur if changing testimony alone cannot undo produced skills or lost opportunities.
causal_loop.critical_cross_component_edge: Category-produced opportunities → behavior used as fresh classification evidence
causal_loop.edge_removal_counterfactual: Profile-independent opportunities remove the behavioral regeneration route; the language route may still survive separately.

strongest_developed_version: After independently verified removal of all historical profiles, model influence and downstream copied records available to a new classifier, an initially assigned category can recur because (i) learned self-description and common evaluator frames persist, and (ii) its earlier opportunity allocation produced skills/behavior now measured as fresh evidence. With matched initial traits and equal stored-data erasure, altering elicitation frames and category-conditioned future opportunities can reduce history-dependent recurrence. The mechanism concerns intervention-produced trajectories, not the mere correct redetection of a pre-existing trait.
verified_erasure_correct_intake_contrast: A fresh intake may be perfectly correct: an earlier assigned category caused real capabilities, and an honest new classifier reports those capabilities after complete erasure. Storage erasure succeeded while category exit did not occur. An external opportunity footprint is inherited classification-loop material, not by itself novelty or evidence of misconduct. The narrower audit separates correct redetection of produced state, retained records, pre-existing traits and framing-dependent reports; it does not promise to erase the person's experiences or require knowingly false classification.
added_assumptions: New classification can update opportunity allocation, completing the return; a static one-off labeling effect is not sufficient.
Learned reporting and produced behavior have nonzero causal effects on fresh classification, with relevant persistence over the observation horizon.
Historical labels/embeddings/profile copies do not reach new evaluators; participant memory is not mistakenly called a retained provider record.
Alternative elicitation changes reporting frames without dictating a desired classification; changing opportunity schedules may affect future behavior without immediately undoing prior skills.
Initial traits and stable true-category explanations must be controlled; no premise that sincere testimony or accurate recognition is intrinsically bad.
Positive loop gains alone do not prove multiple equilibria, hysteresis, or a positive factorial interaction.

state: R_t: stored/model/copy information accessible to classifier
closure: C_t = g(E_t), with R_t set to zero at reset
paired_variables: Verified storage erasure versus post-reset causal recurrence
Fresh-evidence accuracy versus dependence on earlier assigned category
explicit_state_model.critical_cross_edge: Category-produced opportunities → behavior used as fresh classification evidence
explicit_state_model.cross_edge_removal: Make future opportunity assignment independent of C_t, holding total resources constant. This removes the prospective opportunity-produced return; a residual language path and pre-existing behavior stock may persist. A claim that this immediately eliminates all recurrence would exceed the graph.
explicit_state_model.measurement: At each horizon, estimate the difference in recurrence of the sealed initial category after randomized initial labeling, holding initial traits fixed. Decompose changes under frame and opportunity interventions. Do not call plain classification accuracy or prevalence a regeneration-gain estimate.
explicit_state_model.formal_status: Conditional causal specification, not a new theorem or proved equilibrium.

KNOWN: Classification can co-produce self-understanding and behavior through institutions, experts and knowledge; this multichannel loop is already close in Hacking.
Definitions and discriminatory opportunity structures can create later evidence apparently confirming them; institutional intervention is inherited from self-fulfilling-prophecy analysis.
Categorical attachment, control over its removal and practical irreversibility are explicit concerns in classification infrastructure theory.
Prediction-induced distribution change, feedback-driven apparent confirmation and history-dependent population response are inherited formal/conceptual ingredients.
The fact that a reset of machine parameters or storage need not reset social/behavioral state is not by itself a substantive new mechanism.
preliminary_NEW_RESIDUE: A narrow development target is an independently verified erasure experiment estimating how much post-reset category recurrence is produced through persistent reporting frames versus opportunity-created behavior. The inspected works do not establish whether that exact decomposition and matched intervention contrast is already developed elsewhere; this is an inspection gap, not verified originality.
what_expert_would_miss: An expert knowing Hacking, Merton and stateful performativity would not miss the distributed loop or the need to change institutions. What the record offers is a concrete erasure-audit estimand separating record retention from manufactured fresh evidence; no important conceptual omission in those expert theories has been established.

provisional_classification.reason: Whole-loop neighbors are substantive, but limited book/essay inspection and no direct study of the exact erasure audit do not establish either historical novelty or full equivalence of the precise experiment.

minimum_matched_experiment.setting: Consenting participants in a low-stakes fictional training/cooperative task; no medical diagnosis, essential services or harmful deprivation.
minimum_matched_experiment.design: Randomize an initial arbitrary category among participants with matched baseline skills. Allow category-framed reflection and category-conditioned practice to create trajectories, then erase all classifier-facing historical records and model contributions. Use genuinely fresh evaluators and intake. A sealed initial-category key remains only with experiment auditors.
minimum_matched_experiment.contrast: After identical verified erasure, cross neutral/alternate self-description elicitation with independent/category-conditioned future opportunities. Hold evaluator architecture, resource totals and underlying tasks fixed; separately randomize evaluator frames or use frame-blinded behavioral assessments.
measurements: Causal effect of initial arbitrary assignment on post-reset category
Fresh interview/frame dependence and inter-evaluator residual covariance
Objective behavior/capability change attributable to opportunity assignment
Recurrence over horizons short and long enough for retained capability stock to decay or be altered
minimum_matched_experiment.primary_prediction: Recurrence due to the opportunity route falls when the classification→opportunity→future-behavior return is removed; framing intervention changes the reporting route. Effects can be additive: superadditive interaction is not necessary.
rival_controls: A pre-existing stable trait correctly redetected
Repeated evaluators sharing a frame without any produced behavior
Allocation-induced observation exposure rather than changed abilities
Regression to the mean or task-difficulty change

beneficial_same_mechanism_case: A voluntary training-support identity gives a person a shared language for their needs, tailored opportunities build the relevant capacities, and fresh testimony/behavior secures continued wanted recognition at a replacement institution after data erasure. The same reporting→recognition→opportunity→behavior→recognition return supplies continuity; benefit is measured against the person's ongoing preference, not assumed from institutional persistence.
neutral_control: Category labels influence neither practice opportunities nor later interpretation; fresh evaluation uses baseline traits and blinded evidence. A stable true trait may still recur, which is not the target loop.
strongest_falsifier: With verified erasure, randomized initial category has no causal effect on post-reset classification or newly developed behavior across frames/opportunity conditions; alternatively, all observed recurrence is explained by genuine prior traits or retained data. This falsifies the proposed regeneration mechanism in the setting, not every form of classification looping.
counterexample_and_escape: Fresh evaluators can correctly reject learned category language when task evidence contradicts it.
Category-based opportunities can produce divergence or compensatory improvement rather than category-congruent behavior; edge signs are empirical.
Independent opportunities break future reproduction but do not retroactively erase skills; demanding immediate reset effects is an invalid stronger hypothesis.

further_mutation.proposal: Hold actual behavioral skill stocks fixed and compare two institutions that infer the same category equally accurately after erasure, but only one has a category-blind exit pathway for accessing future opportunities. Predict divergent long-run category recurrence despite equal initial inference accuracy.
further_mutation.what_changes: Moves from detecting persistent evidence to whether an exit pathway can decouple accurate recognition from future trajectory reproduction.
further_mutation.known_inheritance: Institutional exit, self-fulfilling dynamics and stateful response remain genetic material; this mutation is unsearched and carries no novelty verdict.

inspection_limits: Six primary works do not establish exhaustive prior art or priority.
Books/essays inspected selectively; exact coverage is in each source record.
No systematic review of contemporary identity-reset or erasure-policy scholarship; three erasure-related searches yielded no verified exact composition, which is not evidence of absence.
No real-world causal estimates, proof of erasure completeness, equilibrium proof or participant-welfare result.
preservation: Raw and developed versions unchanged; this court is additive.
